result.summary: Removing the clamp reintroduces incorrect progress and completion indicators for extracted files.

findings.title: Completed extracted files display over 100% and lose completion indicators
findings.body: For local_size=20 and remote_size=10, this now produces 200 instead of 100. transfer-row.component.html renders that percentage directly (line 28), while its success styling and “Done” label require exactly 100 (lines 33 and 53). The width clamp at line 35 protects only bar width. Extracted files larger than their archives therefore show misleading progress and lose completion indicators. Existing service test vectors explicitly expect 100 for these inputs.
findings.recommendation: Restore Math.min(100, ...) and retain the existing regression cases for local sizes exceeding remote sizes.

next_steps: Restore the percentage bound and run the ViewFileService unit tests.
